fields.change: 6. data or config, code, or SQL

gaps.sql-only: the value lives in a SQL function or table; the engine the matrix runs never reads it
gaps.outside-hunt: a town system the matrix does not simulate: town work (gathering, benches, crafting), the market, sinks past the store, the House
gaps.not-in-runs: the engine reads it and cell.mjs could play it, but no matrix RUN plays that mode (the Tower, the Catacombs, scaled hunts, boss halls and calls, the yard, live events)
gaps.harness-fixed: the harness sets this itself (skills from tools/balance-sim/skill-lines.mjs, kits from grid-kit.mjs), so a patch to the game number does not reach a cell
gaps.player-policy: a player choice (stance, rotation, food thresholds, party mix past the lineups): the matrix plays one default
gaps.no-seam: the engine has no seam to switch it on in a cell (Talent unlocks and Linger until R20's "when" column)
gaps.not-built: ruled or staged but not in the engine (fists, PvP, linings, the Luck bar, the hall number)
gaps.dead: nothing on the hunt path reads it: a perturbation changes no outcome
